# A real SX1262 (a wing with a TCXO on DIO3) under RadioLib 7.7.1 and
# Meshtastic 2.8.2 (e506f8a) on an ESP32-S3, region JP, LongFast: boot,
# radio init, a want_ack direct message received, two CADs (the first
# finding the channel busy), the routing ACK sent, a 39-byte reply received,
# the periodic warm sleep and Calibrate. From a RADIOLIB_DEBUG_SPI capture,
# 2026-10-03. Node numbers are synthetic and every frame past its 16-byte
# Meshtastic header is filler, so nothing here decrypts.
#
# One item per line, in time order (us, the DUT's clock as RadioLib stamped
# the print after each window):
#   X <us>                       NRESET pulled low and released; the next
#                                window follows the release at once
#   W <us> <mosi> <miso>         one chip-select window, as the real chip answered
#   R <us> <payload> <rssi dBm> <snr cdB> <signal rssi dBm>
#                                a frame on the radio's channel starts
#   C <us>                       a one-byte frame, preamble 8, on the radio's channel
#   N <us> <dBm>                 the noise floor GetRssiInst reads
#   E <us> <text>                the DUT's own log, for orientation
# X, R, C and N come from the windows: the payload a ReadBuffer returned
# and the signal GetPacketStatus reported, placed so RxDone falls before
# the first window that shows it; a frame on the channel for each CAD that
# reported CadDetected; the noise floor each GetRssiInst read.
